name: agentflow
description: Board-first workflow management for daily dev work, where the workers are AI agents.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm --workspace web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace packages/core run typecheck && npm --workspace web run typecheck && npm --workspace worker run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:web && npm run test:worker
scripts.lint: npm --workspace packages/core run lint && npm --workspace web run lint && npm --workspace worker run lint

overridesComment: deepmerge-ts <8 has a stack-exhaustion advisory (GHSA-ggr8-5vv4-36mx). It reaches us only through the Prisma CLI's config loader, and no Prisma release pins a fixed version yet. Drop this override once @prisma/config ships one.
